notes: Fixed the send queue: messages typed while the agent is working are now held locally in a QUEUED strip with per-message X delete and clear, then sent one at a time after the current turn. This removes the undeletable IN QUEUE previews and the stale/backlogged queue messages. Plus offline transcript cache, connection diagnostics/auto-heal, continuous voice dictation, usage CSV share, transcript .md share, and background-sync interval.
